newsitem.title: CONGO: Son kills father over pocket money in Congo.
newsitem.headline: Son kills father over pocket money in Congo.

text.p: A son killed his father with a bullet to the head in the Central African state of Congo after a dispute over pocket money for New Year celebrations, state radio reported on Wednesday.

The son, whose age was not immediately clear, killed his father on Tuesday after he refused to give him money to go out celebrating with his friends. The father owned a drinks kiosk in Makelekele in the south of the capital Brazzaville.
